name: Digital Voice
description: HRWS-DV: FreeDV-style open digital voice, studio-to-studio. LPC vocoder at 1600/2600/3200 bit/s, Golay(24,12) on the critical bits, DQPSK/D8PSK multicarrier for SSB and FM voice channels or 4FSK for the 9k6 data jack. PTT, PTT lock and VOX, FreeDV SNR squelch, live mic to rig, WAV in/out, loopback lab.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
